comment: ENHANCEMENT: other projects' recompiled games the launcher can START (launch only, off by default, pref 'unofficial'). The launcher never downloads, builds or patches them; the player points a card at an already-built exe. Facts read from each project's README (2026-11-17).

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction
entries.layout: tod.exe sits in the game folder beside game/, elf/, gamedata/, cache/, log/ and tod.ini (the project's release zip folder, e.g. tod-recomp-1.3.0).
entries.requires: Windows 10/11 x64, AVX2, Direct3D 12; your own European disc (BCES00052 v1.00).

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Into the Nexus
entries.layout: RecompFolder\NexusRecomp.exe, made by that project's RecompBuilder.exe (with settings.txt and PS3_GAME\USRDIR\EBOOT.elf).
entries.requires: Windows 10/11 x64, AVX2, Vulkan 1.3 GPU; your own dump (BCUS99245 v1.00) and a decrypted EBOOT.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time
entries.layout: The project's own launcher (RaCACiT Launcher.exe, from its release zip) sets the game up and starts the newest build in builds\v<number>\RaCACiT.exe; settings, saves and log.txt live in that launcher's folder, so start its launcher.
entries.requires: Windows x64, Vulkan; your own decrypted North American disc (BCUS98124): EBOOT.ELF and USRDIR.
